# terrakube_project (Resource)

Create a project and bind it to an organization. Projects group workspaces together and enable project-scoped team access via `terrakube_project_access`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "terrakube_project" "project" {
  name            = "sample-project"
  organization_id = data.terrakube_organization.org.id
  description     = "Groups workspaces for the sample application"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Project name, unique within the organization
- `organization_id` (String) Terrakube organization id

### Optional

- `description` (String) Project description

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Project Id

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
# Project can be imported with organization_id,id
terraform import terrakube_project.example 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000
```
